stance_rationale: weights.csv is a real 216-date walk-forward schedule and security-level hard constraints pass, but the selected HRP_Quarterly portfolio breaches the CVaR cap and the package still emits actionable target_weights. The optimizer also re-estimates per-date Σ outside a Risk-owned time-series covariance handoff, does not use confidence-aware sizing despite RF-A1, and lacks optimizer-specific Charter §8 evidence.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: HRP_Quarterly has the highest net_IR among turnover-passing candidates, but all 10 candidates fail the CVaR cap.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: 4.3914 * 0.0015 * 2 = 0.01317, matching the rounded 15bps one-way round-trip cost.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: 80% PG2 / 20% Iter 5 is described, but tdc_vs_pg2 is only a cross-section Jaccard proxy and blended SR/MDD/IR remain TBD.

critical_concerns.description: Selected HRP_Quarterly has cvar95_daily_proxy=0.0261 versus the 0.025 cap, and every candidate has pass_cvar_cap=false; an infeasibility report is necessary, but it does not make breached target_weights admissible.

run_optimizer_iter5.R computes per-sig_date LW covariance from alpha_scores returns for the historical schedule instead of consuming Risk-owned per-date Σ artifacts; only the final as_of target is aligned to covariance.parquet.

Alpha RF-A1 remains active with subperiod_stability=0.0598 and DSR=0.3452, but selected HRP_Quarterly has confidence_used=false; testing confidence-aware MVO as an unselected candidate does not address final sizing.

CRISIS alpha IC is -0.1727 with only 5 months, yet CRISIS security weights reach 0.12655; the prompt-required small-sample crisis boundary shrink toward 0.10 is not enforced, even though cash and pooled Σ are explicit.

The task request says monthly rebalance and the base context requires per-sig_date weight recomputation, but HRP_Quarterly creates held months with 1055 weighted rows ranked outside the same-date top 20 and average 28.6% weight outside current top-20 alpha on affected dates.

The infeasibility report says all 10 candidates exceed the turnover cap, but HRP_Quarterly turnover is 4.3914 and four candidates pass pass_to_cap; the integration note also cites 762% turnover rather than the selected 439%.
optimizer_challenge_note.md is absent, artifact_lineage.json has alpha and risk entries only, and no final optimization_package.json lineage exists; optimizer AX-008 triangulation is incomplete.
Direct TDC versus MEGA_05/PG2 is not measured, replacement and 80/20 integration have no blended SR/MDD/IR, and the package defers the admission evidence to Forge.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv has 216 as_of_dates from 2006-01-01 to 2023-12-01 and is not a single-snapshot artifact.
Security-only hard constraints pass: max risk names=20, max risk weight=0.20, all risk weights are non-negative, and per-date total weights including CASH sum to 1 within numerical tolerance.
Liquidity/universe audit passed for all 3607 risk rows: every weighted ticker is KOSPI200 or KOSDAQ150 and lagged AvgTV20 minimum is about 202.0m KRW.
alpha_scores.parquet is a proper time-series panel with 240 signal dates, 70065 rows, 773 tickers, and Date x Ticker x score columns.
covariance.parquet is symmetric PSD with min eigenvalue 0.0033009419 and condition number 24.3401; covariance_pooled_fallback.parquet is PSD with condition number 100.
CRISIS and CAUTION rows in the current weights.csv use pooled-fallback sigma labels; the remaining issue is crisis sizing, not fallback labeling.

Whether any admissible portfolio can satisfy both turnover <600% and cvar95_daily_proxy <=2.5% under semiannual rebalance, explicit CVaR optimization, HRP+DD brake, no-trade bands, or ADV pacing.
Whether monthly-return CVaR divided by sqrt(21) is sufficient for a daily CVaR cap, or daily realized portfolio returns are required.
Whether quarterly held weights are acceptable despite request.json rebalance_frequency=monthly and base walk-forward language requiring per-sig_date reoptimization.
Whether direct PG2 NAV or active-book data can be made available for real TDC and 80/20 admission metrics.
Whether CASH should be formally exempted from max_names and 0.20 per-name bounds in the Hook schema rather than handled by note.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a CVaR-breaching HRP_Quarterly schedule can be handed off as actionable because Forge may later add inertia, ADV pacing, or other controls.
